label: Any two actual beings whose esse is their essence share one nature
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: any two beings in act as to being, each of whose represented esse equals its represented essence, share one nature (SharesNature), so that their being two would be a multiplication of that nature. De ente c.3 [69874] treats 'a thing that is esse tantum' as one nature without arguing it. This is the #697 individuation gap (UNRECEIVED-ESSE-INDIVIDUATION-BRIDGE). Rival: two such beings differ as wholes, by primitive individuation or by two different whole essences each identical with its own esse, without being a multiplication of a common nature; TwoSourcesControl satisfies every other input of the at-most-one argument without this premise.
